title: Granularity ladder and KKH26 march are the SAME I(delta) curve below/above the knee
wall: W-Johnson (BGK / Paley sqrt-cancellation for thin mu_n)
evidence: Two exact integer probes at proper-subgroup dyadic n=2^mu (mu=3..6, plus prize-scale mu=8/10/20/30 arithmetic): scripts/probes/_407_conn/probe_C037_iknee.py and probe_C037_rate.py. (1) The in-tree ladder cap (badScalars_card_le <= e under NoWeightLE(3(e-1)), GranularityLadderRS.lean / UniversalStaircaseCollapse.lean) pins delta*=e/n only for delta <= (n-k)/(3n), strictly BELOW Johnson (e.g. n=32,k=16: ladder reach 0.188 < Johnson 0.293). (2) The in-tree march cap (#bad*(d+2) <= C(n,d+2), march_badScalars_card_mul_le in KKH26CeilingMarch.lean) pins delta*=1-r/n for the dimension-(r-1) code. CRUCIAL: the machine-proven canonical march (kkh26_march_deltaStar_pin_canonical) requires r^2 <= 2^mu+1, i.e. r <= sqrt(n), so dimension k=r-1 <= sqrt(n)-1 and rate rho=(r-1)/n -> 0 (n=2^8: max rho 0.059; n=2^20: 0.001; n=2^30: 3e-5). The non-canonical pin (r=Theta(n), prize rate rho in {1/2,1/4,1/8,1/16}) needs a prime p > (2^mu)^(2^(mu-1)) ~ n^(n/2), astronomically beyond the prize q ~ n^4..5 (n=2^8 needs log2(p)>n^(n/2) vs prize log2(q)~36). Hence at FIXED prize rate the march provides NO above-Johnson pin. For a fixed code there is a genuine unmapped gap region (e.g. fixed k=8,n=32: ladder reaches 0.281, the only march for that dim sits at 0.719, the interval (0.281,0.719) has no in-tree count) -- but that gap is exactly the open core, not a newly localized object.
honest_note: The connection's STRUCTURAL reframing is correct and genuinely insightful: sup{delta : I(delta) <= q*eps*} = 'locate the knee where the worst-case bad-scalar count first exceeds the budget', with the ladder mapping the linear low end and the march mapping a super-poly high end. As geometry this is true and a clean way to phrase the open core. The connection FAILS as a closure or reduction for three reasons established by the probes: (a) the two staircases pin DIFFERENT codes (different dimension k) at the same radius -- they are not one I(delta) for one fixed code; (b) the proven (canonical) march above-Johnson pin is a VANISHING-rate pin (r <= sqrt(n), rho -> 0; the Diamond-Gruen regime the DISPROOF_LOG flags as explicitly NOT the prize), and the prize-rate march pin is vacuous (needs p ~ n^(n/2)); (c) the march's C(n,r)/r bound is a combinatorial tuple-incidence UPPER bound on bad scalars, not a character-sum cancellation -- it cannot supply an I(delta) VALUE near the knee at prize rate, so the attack-plan's predicted knee formula 1-rho-H(rho)/(beta log n) is an unverifiable conjecture, not a consequence of the unification. The 'knee' therefore welds back to W-Johnson / BGK sqrt-cancellation for thin mu_n (the recognized 25-year-open core). No new tractable sub-statement was isolated beyond restating the existing open core geometrically, so the honest label is OPEN, not REDUCED. The structural unification piece is PARTIAL-true (true as a picture, false as 'one curve at prize rate'). Did not run a full brute-force I(delta) at a prize prime (infeasible); relied on the in-tree proven counts and their proven validity regions, which is what determines the answer.
